name: Ayush Rai
tagline: I build software, study how systems behave under real constraints, and keep a working record of what I learn.
intro: This site is my personal knowledge system; notes on the [projects](projects) I ship, the [engineering](engineering) and [artificial intelligence](ai) work behind them, and the [research](research), [writing](writing), and [learning](learning) that shape how I think.

I care about useful software, measurable [impact](impact), and products that solve real user and [business](business) problems. I document [systems](systems), [open source](open-source) work, [communities](communities) I take part in, and the slower parts of the path: [reading](reading), [fitness](fitness), [timeline](timeline), and a [gallery](gallery) of photographs.
Deeper pages hold the evidence. Start wherever curiosity points.
